model_input.dataset: CSE-CIC-IDS2018 prepared Stage 5D source-file holdout features
model_input.note: Stage 5 artifacts contain configurations and evaluation outputs; no reusable trained RF artifact was found in the project tree.

live_input.unit: rule-stat snapshot, not CICFlowMeter flow row

classification_definitions.EXACT: same quantity and semantics are represented in live observations
classification_definitions.DERIVABLE: deterministically computable from current live observations without meaning change
classification_definitions.APPROXIMATION_REQUIRED: computable only by changing/approximating semantics; prohibited for live model input
classification_definitions.SEMANTICALLY_INCOMPATIBLE: an apparently related live field exists but measures a different quantity

feature_compatibility.reason: FlowRecord.ip_protocol is the IP protocol number; it matches CICFlowMeter Protocol when the OpenFlow match contains ip_proto. The field is optional on wildcarded/non-IP entries, so an individual record may still be rejected for a missing value.

FlowRecord.duration_seconds is the age of an installed OpenFlow rule at the snapshot. CICFlowMeter Flow Duration describes the packet-derived bidirectional flow duration (reported in a different unit/semantic interval); converting seconds to microseconds would not make the underlying quantity equivalent.
